item.title: Video Notes
item.description: Photoshop transparent background https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5ZiJ9_QNdRw To make a video background transparent in Photoshop, you can work with the video timeline feature and export it as a file that supports transparency. Here’s a brief overview: Open the video file in Photoshop. Work on the layers: Ensure the video’s layer is unlocked. Use selection tools like Quick Selection or the Lasso Tool to isolate the background. Create a mask: Add a layer mask to hide or remove the background. Adjust the mask as needed to refine the transparency.
